_note: Run: python3 bin/mutate.py --spec mutations/run-ci-locally-verdict.json (base interpreter; these tests need neither docker nor PyYAML). Proves the distinction the row-isolation test leans on is not vacuous: a step that ran and failed (EXIT_STEP_FAILED) must not share an exit code with a run that reached no verdict (EXIT_NO_VERDICT). Collapsing the two is exactly the bug that made a failed apt-get during the runner-image build read as 'the second matrix row saw a file the first one wrote' -- an infrastructure hiccup wearing the mask of the property under test. See tests.test_run_ci_locally.TestAVerdictIsNotTheSameAsNoVerdict.

targets.label: a failed step is reported as no verdict, so skipping on no-verdict would swallow a real leak
targets.old: return EXIT_STEP_FAILED if self.failures() else EXIT_OK
targets.new: return EXIT_NO_VERDICT if self.failures() else EXIT_OK
